common_intent_requirements.text: 把一个橡胶球从手里静止松开
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把一个橡胶球从手里静止松开
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: one hand holding a rubber ball still above a hard floor. Keep the whole drop and the floor contact area inside the composition. The fingers open without pushing the ball, and the hand withdraws.

common_intent_requirements.text: 让它在硬地板上弹跳几下后慢慢停下来
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 让它在硬地板上弹跳几下后慢慢停下来
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: It makes several visible bounces, each upward motion following a floor contact. Across the sequence, the overall bounce height and motion gradually diminish until the ball settles and comes to rest on the floor.

physics_checks.criterion: 反弹发生在地面接触之后，且无后续供能时反弹包络总体减弱。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 至少能辨认落地接触和后续反弹，并比较前后反弹的整体幅度。
fail_examples: 球尚未接触地板就反向弹起
无新外力时后期反弹明显越来越高
地板不变形却把球直接吞没或送回手中
not_required: 允许微小不规则弹跳和末期滚动
不要求每次反弹高度严格单调或精确恢复系数

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
